additional_info.subject: Issue Description
additional_info.body:
During commissioning, CP2 did not start the charging session. The session was interrupted at P02-Parameter Discover.
We initially looked for the problem in the XD16 blocks (we corrected all the cables and checked the fastenings), and we also checked the wiring in all ecoG units. This also had no effect.
Everything is fine with CP1.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0434088-DC/Si-D/PL - [Y2/T3 314164726004] CP2 not starting charging session CRM:02919000046
additional_info.body:
Dear Szymon Brodowicz,
Hope you're doing well.
We have reviewed the logs from the reported time and found that a
V2G message response failure
occurred, which led to the charging session failure.
We recommend attempting to charge the vehicle on
both outlets
. If
CP2
is still not functioning, please collect the
ECOG logs
if you are on-site. Otherwise, feel free to share the
timestamp
of the issue with us, and we will escalate it to our expert team for further assistance if needed.
Additionally, we have observed that
both outlets are currently marked as inoperative
. Kindly make it operative before start charging.
Please let us know if you have query.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar

change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0434088-DC/Si-D/PL - [Y2/T3 314164726004] CP2 not starting charging session CRM:02919000046
additional_info.body:
Dear all,
I would like to ask for your urgent support. Unfortunately, today we tried to repair the charger, but none of our actions were successful.
We worked until late hours because it is a location very far from our office, tomorrow morning we want to move on unfortunately we have no idea what to do next.
Long story short:
Our problem:
only on the CP2the charging session does not start. The cable is not locked by the car. Appears to be a lack of V2G communication. Session is interpting on P02_Parameter Discovery..

What we did:
We replaced KF12 and KF14
We checked every connection in area of controllers and benders.
We checked continuity of charging cables and communication cables going to KF12
Charging plug look also good.
The customer has technical acceptance of two of our chargers scheduled for Friday. This is one of them, so I would very much appreciate your taking action as soon as possible. We are on site from tomorrow morning i.e. 10.07 and are looking further for the source of the problem.
